# MONTREAL.AI

MONTREAL.AI is the permanent founder-controlled parent institution behind GoalOS and a federation of distinctive intelligence Maisons.

Canonical principles:
- AI creates output. GoalOS creates proof.
- Power must earn authority.
- Execute, Validate, Accept, Admit and Settle are distinct acts.
- Public proof. Private capability. Governed authority.
- Only validated, scoped, rights-cleared and revocable capability may compound.
- Cryptography can prove commitments and authorization paths; it cannot independently prove that an off-chain event was true.
